text:
1. 16. 4. 10. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ. Atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ. Evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti. Atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye atthamaññāya dhammaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ na paṭipajjanti.
